project.name: Respawn Tahmid — Gaming Creator Website
project.purpose: Build a polished, responsive personal gaming website and social hub for Respawn Tahmid. The website should make the creator recognizable, help visitors find every social platform, promote livestreams, and encourage people to subscribe and join the community.
project.build_instruction: Build a complete responsive website using this JSON as the source of truth. IMPORTANT BRAND RULE: This is a VARIETY GAMING channel website, not a VALORANT-only website. Mention VALORANT only as one game among many. Keep page layout, video cards, SEO, and copy flexible for current and future games. The owner will upload the selected logo and banner separately; use them as primary brand references.

brand.tagline: I die. I respawn. I come back harder.
brand.supporting_line: The game never stops—and neither do I.
brand.creator_description: A gaming creator and daily livestreamer who plays a variety of games. VALORANT is one of the games featured on the channel, alongside other current and future games.
brand.brand_goal: Make visitors recognize Respawn Tahmid as an authentic variety-gaming creator with a consistent identity across games and platforms—not a VALORANT-only channel or a generic AI gaming brand.

logo.expected_input: The owner will upload/provide the selected Respawn Tahmid logo separately.
logo.usage: Use as the primary brand mark for the navbar, footer, favicon if suitable, and social/contact areas.
instructions: Use the supplied logo as the source of truth.
Do not redraw, retype, or replace the logo unless explicitly asked.
Preserve its proportions and transparency if present.
If the logo contains a portrait, do not alter the creator's recognizable facial features.

youtube_banner.expected_input: The owner will upload/provide the selected YouTube banner separately.
youtube_banner.usage: Use as visual inspiration for the website hero and brand styling, not as a stretched full-page background.
instructions: Do not stretch or crop it in a way that distorts the face or wordmark.
Extract the visual direction—gritty textures, red brush strokes, strong contrast—and adapt it to a clean website layout.
The website must still look good on mobile even if the banner is not displayed in full.

creator_portrait.expected_input: Use the portrait included in the supplied logo/banner when available; otherwise provide an optional portrait upload slot.
instructions: Keep the creator's real appearance recognizable.
Avoid turning the portrait into a fantasy character or overly artificial AI face.
Use tasteful lighting and crop adjustments only.

visual_design.theme: Dark esports / gaming creator brand, bold but clean and usable.

typography.headings: Anton or Bebas Neue, with a strong condensed uppercase style
typography.body: Inter or a similar clean sans-serif
rules: Use bold uppercase display type for short headings only.
Keep paragraph text readable and restrained.
Do not use too many fonts.
Avoid excessive distressed effects on body text.

design_rules: Do not fill every section with neon effects, particles, or red glow.
Use red as an accent for buttons, links, active states, and important labels.
Keep generous spacing and strong visual hierarchy.
Use subtle hover transitions, not distracting animations.
Use the supplied logo and banner as brand references, not as excuses to overcrowd the page.

website_structure.name: Sticky navigation
requirements: Logo on the left.
Navigation links: Home, About, Watch Live, Socials.
A high-contrast Subscribe button on the right.
On mobile, use a compact accessible menu.
Do not let the navigation cover content when scrolling.

website_structure.name: Main hero
website_structure.headline: RESPAWN TAHMID
website_structure.subheadline: I die. I respawn. I come back harder.
website_structure.description: Gaming, daily livestreams, and a community that keeps coming back.
visual_guidance: Keep the first screen clear and immediately recognizable.
Use a dark background with restrained red accents.
Do not invent a live badge or claim the creator is live unless live status is actually verified.
On mobile, stack content cleanly and keep both buttons easy to tap.
Do not make any single game the central identity of the homepage.

website_structure.name: Watch and follow
website_structure.headline: CATCH THE NEXT DROP
website_structure.description: Find Respawn Tahmid on your preferred streaming platform.
functional_notes: Open external platforms in a new tab with safe link attributes.
Do not show a false live status.
Optionally support a YouTube/Twitch embed only if the owner later provides the correct channel/video details.
If embeds are not configured, show platform cards instead.
Keep the streaming experience game-agnostic so any current or future game fits naturally.

website_structure.name: About the creator
website_structure.headline: THE PLAYER BEHIND THE RESPAWN
website_structure.copy: I'm Respawn Tahmid. I stream gaming every day and play a variety of games. VALORANT is one part of the channel, but there's always room for other games, new releases, and different kinds of gameplay. Whether you're here for the games, the live chat, or the community, welcome in.
design_notes: Use the supplied portrait or logo.
Do not invent the creator's age, rank, professional status, or personal biography.

website_structure.name: Social media hub
website_structure.headline: STAY IN THE LOOP
website_structure.description: Follow, watch, and join the community wherever you hang out.
design_notes: Use recognizable platform icons where licensing and icon availability permit.
Make each card clickable and keyboard accessible.
Keep the platform names visible; do not rely on icons alone.

website_structure.name: Latest videos and clips
website_structure.headline: LATEST CONTENT
website_structure.description: Recent streams, gameplay, highlights, and clips from a variety of games.
requirements: Build a reusable grid for video cards.
Allow each video card to show its own game title, thumbnail, title, and URL.
Use real video URLs and thumbnails supplied by the owner.
Until content is provided, show clearly editable placeholder cards in the editor, not fake published videos.
Support multiple games and future releases without redesigning the page.
If a YouTube channel URL or playlist is later provided, make it easy to connect.

website_structure.name: Subscriber challenge
website_structure.headline: ROAD TO 1K
website_structure.copy: The goal is 1,000 subscribers. Be part of the journey.
requirements: Make this a campaign section that can be enabled or hidden.
Do not display an invented current subscriber count or fake progress bar.
If a progress bar is included, make the current count editable by the owner and label it clearly.
Use a strong subscribe CTA that links to the real YouTube channel URL once provided.

website_structure.name: Footer
requirements: Show the logo or wordmark.
Include a compact set of social links.
Include a back-to-top link.
Use the line: I die. I respawn. I come back harder.
Keep the footer simple and mobile-friendly.

required: Fully responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
All social links must open the correct external destinations.
Clear hover, focus, and pressed states for interactive elements.
Optimized images and lazy loading for below-the-fold media.
A custom favicon using the supplied logo if a suitable square version exists.
Easy-to-edit centralized configuration for social links and content.
optional: A reduced-motion mode that respects the user's system preference.
A lightweight YouTube video embed once the channel/video URL is provided.
A simple contact link only if the owner provides an email address.
do_not: Do not invent an email address.
Do not invent YouTube video URLs or a YouTube channel URL.
Do not show a fake live indicator, fake viewer count, fake subscriber count, fake testimonials, or fake sponsors.
Do not add a payment system, account login, or unnecessary database.
Do not use loud animations that make the page hard to read.
Do not replace the supplied logo/banner with newly generated branding.

technical_expectations.output: A complete working website project with clear run instructions.
technical_expectations.preferred_approach: Use a modern responsive frontend stack supported by Google AI Studio; keep the implementation straightforward and maintainable.
code_quality: Use reusable components for navigation, social cards, buttons, and content cards.
Keep brand text, colors, URLs, and editable content in a central configuration file.
Use semantic HTML and accessible labels.
Use responsive image sizing and avoid layout shifts.
Provide a clear list of placeholders that the owner still needs to fill in.

seo.meta_description: Join Respawn Tahmid for daily gaming livestreams, gameplay, highlights, and a variety of games. Connect across YouTube, Twitch, Kick, TikTok, Instagram, and Discord.
requirements: Use one clear H1.
Use descriptive page titles and metadata.
Add social preview metadata where appropriate.
Do not add unsupported claims.

owner_checklist_before_launch: Upload the chosen Respawn Tahmid logo to Google AI Studio.
Upload the chosen YouTube banner as a visual reference.
Replace ADD_YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_URL with the real YouTube channel URL.
Provide real video links and thumbnails if the Recent Content section should show actual content.
Check all social links on mobile and desktop.
Preview the site at narrow mobile widths before publishing.
